info.name: Aangan Dairy - Rider Mobile App API
info.description:
Token-based (Laravel Sanctum) API for the rider delivery mobile app. Every request except Login requires the Bearer token returned by Login. The Login request's test script automatically saves the token into the `token` collection variable, so all other requests work immediately after a successful login.

Base URL is controlled by the `base_url` collection variable (defaults to a local dev server — update it to your environment).

variable.description: Set this to a delivery's `id` (from List Deliveries) to test the delivery-detail and status-transition requests.

request.description:
Exchanges rider credentials for a bearer token. Rejects accounts that aren't riders (422) and inactive rider accounts (422). Rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP.

Response:
```json
{
  "token": "1|abcdef...",
  "rider": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "name": "Ali Rider",
    "phone": "03001234567",
    "zone": "Gulberg",
    "status": "active",
    "wallet_balance": 260.0,
    "is_online": false,
    "is_checked_in": false
  }
}
```
Use `is_online`/`is_checked_in` to set the initial state of the main-screen switch and check-in indicator on app load — don't assume both start false on every login, a rider may still be online/checked-in from an earlier session.
Revokes the current token. Response: `{"message": "Logged out."}`. The token will no longer authenticate any request after this.

query.description: Optional. Filter by delivery_status: pending, assigned, picked_up, out_for_delivery, delivered, failed, returned. Omit to see all orders ever assigned to you.

request.description:
Paginated list of orders assigned to the authenticated rider, newest assignment first. 20 per page.

Response is a standard Laravel paginated resource: `{"data": [...orders], "links": {...}, "meta": {...}}`. See the Wallet/Delivery Detail request for the order object shape.

Single order with its line items. Returns 403 if this order isn't assigned to you.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "order_number": "#1001",
    "customer_name": "Ayesha Khan",
    "customer_phone": "0300-1112233",
    "shipping_address": {
      "address1": "House 12, Street 5",
      "city": "Lahore",
      "province": "Punjab",
      "country": "Pakistan",
      "zip": "54000"
    },
    "delivery_status": "assigned",
    "payment_status": "pending",
    "currency": "PKR",
    "total": 360.0,
    "cod_amount": 360.0,
    "cod_collected": false,
    "assigned_at": "2026-08-05T05:41:32+00:00",
    "picked_up_at": null,
    "delivered_at": null,
    "delivery_failure_reason": null,
    "pod_photo_url": null,
    "pod_signature_url": null,
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "uuid",
        "product_name": "Fresh Milk - 1 Liter",
        "sku": "MILK-1L",
        "quantity": 2,
        "unit_price": 130.0,
        "total_price": 260.0
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
Transitions delivery_status: assigned → picked_up. Returns the updated order (same shape as Get Delivery Detail). 422 if the order isn't currently 'assigned'. 403 if it's not your delivery.
Transitions delivery_status: picked_up → out_for_delivery. 422 if the order hasn't been picked up yet.

Same shape and behavior as Bulk Mark Picked Up, but transitions `picked_up` → `out_for_delivery`. Use this when you're leaving the warehouse with a batch of already-picked-up parcels, instead of marking each one out-for-delivery individually.

Response shape is identical: `{"succeeded": [...full order objects...], "skipped": [{"id": ..., "reason": ...}]}`.

formdata.description: Optional. Delivery photo. image/jpeg or image/png, max 5MB.
Optional. Customer signature image (e.g. exported PNG from a signature-pad canvas), max 2MB.

request.description:
Transitions delivery_status: out_for_delivery → delivered. **At least one of `photo` or `signature` is required** — the request is rejected with a 422 if both are missing (send either, both, but not neither).

Side effects (automatic, no client action needed):
- If the order has `cod_amount` > 0, it's marked `cod_collected: true` and credited to your wallet balance (you now owe the company that cash).
- Your per-delivery earning rate is credited to your wallet (reduces what you owe / increases what the company owes you).

422 if the order isn't currently 'out_for_delivery', or if no photo/signature was attached.

Marks a delivery attempt as failed (customer unreachable, refused, wrong address, etc.). `reason` is required, max 255 chars. Valid from assigned, picked_up, or out_for_delivery. Does not release allocated stock.

Not a dead end: a dispatcher can reassign a failed order back to you (or another rider) from the admin dashboard, which returns it to 'assigned' status in your delivery list — you'll get the same push notification as a brand-new assignment.

Marks the goods as physically returned (never actually handed over) and releases the allocated stock back into inventory. This is an **alternative to Mark Failed**, not a follow-up to it — valid from the same states (assigned, picked_up, out_for_delivery), not from an order that's already 'failed'. Use this when you're turning back with the parcel intact (e.g. customer refuses on the spot) rather than logging a failed attempt that might get retried.

`returned` is terminal — no further status transitions are possible on this order after this call. 422 if the order isn't in an eligible state, 403 if it's not your delivery.

Everything the main screen's summary cards need in one call.

```json
{
  "is_online": true,
  "is_checked_in": true,
  "wallet_balance": 260.0,
  "assigned_orders_count": 3,
  "done_today_count": 5
}
```
`assigned_orders_count` is strictly orders in the `assigned` state (not yet picked up) — it does not include picked_up/out_for_delivery. `done_today_count` is orders you've marked `delivered` today (server date, not the rider's local timezone).

Sets the main-screen switch to online. This is just an availability flag — it does **not** check your location and does **not** by itself make you eligible for new assignments (see Check In for that). Response: `{"is_online": true}`.
Sets the main-screen switch to offline. Independent of check-in status — going offline does not automatically check you out. Response: `{"is_online": false}`.

Location-verified check-in — this is what actually makes you visible on the dispatch board for new assignments. Send the device's current GPS coordinates; the server checks you're within 200 meters of your assigned warehouse.

Success (200):
```json
{
  "is_checked_in": true,
  "checked_in_at": "2026-08-18T09:13:57+00:00",
  "distance_meters": 42.3
}
```

Failure (422) if you're too far away — the message includes your actual distance, useful for showing the rider why it failed:
```json
{ "message": "You need to be within 200m of your warehouse to check in — you are about 850m away." }
```
Also 422 if you have no warehouse assigned, or your warehouse has no location configured — both are dispatcher-side config issues, not something the app can fix.
Checks you out — you immediately stop being eligible for new assignments (existing assigned deliveries are unaffected, you keep them). No location needed. Response: `{"is_checked_in": false}`.

Your current wallet balance and a paginated transaction ledger (20/page, newest first).

**Balance sign convention**: positive = you're holding company money (uncollected COD) that you owe back; negative = the company owes you (credited but unpaid delivery earnings).

Transaction `type` values: `cod_collected`, `cod_settled`, `earning_credited`, `earning_paid`, `adjustment`.

```json
{
  "wallet_balance": 260.0,
  "transactions": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "type": "earning_credited",
      "amount": -100.0,
      "balance_after": 260.0,
      "notes": "Delivery fee for order #1001",
      "created_at": "2026-08-05T05:42:27+00:00"
    },
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "type": "cod_collected",
      "amount": 360.0,
      "balance_after": 360.0,
      "notes": "COD collected for order #1001",
      "created_at": "2026-08-05T05:42:27+00:00"
    }
  ],
  "meta": { "current_page": 1, "last_page": 1, "total": 2 }
}
```

Settlements (handing cash to the company, getting paid earnings) are recorded by dispatch staff from the admin dashboard, not from this API — they'll show up here as `cod_settled` / `earning_paid` entries.

Records a GPS ping. `latitude` (-90 to 90) and `longitude` (-180 to 180) are required; `accuracy_meters` is optional.

Recommended ping interval: every 30-60 seconds while the app is active/on a delivery — balance battery/data usage against tracking freshness. Every ping is kept (full history), so avoid pinging much more frequently than that.

Response: `{"message": "Location recorded."}`

Registers/updates this device's Firebase Cloud Messaging token so the server can push 'new delivery assigned' notifications. Call this after login and whenever Firebase issues a new/refreshed token (standard FCM token-rotation handling on the client SDK).

Response: `{"message": "Device token registered."}`
